result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback by limiting any Order Form commitment to the current 12-month term, permitting reduction on 30 days’ notice, and replacing take-or-pay liability with a true-up. It changes only the minimum-commitment provision and preserves unrelated protections. Drafting quality is reduced because “true-up of Fees for Services actually ordered” does not clearly define the true-up mechanics, and Section 12.3’s unqualified statement that no minimum-volume commitment exists may conflict with minimum commitments permitted under Section 2.1.
